title: The deleted <video> outlived by its dependents, and a catalog default that could never match
rootCause: Slice 16 deleted MediaPlayerStage, the only <video ref={videoRef}> in src/. The sweep it ran was for the COMPONENT; what other code depended on was the ELEMENT. videoRef has been null in every window since, and three surfaces kept asking it questions.
secondIndependentDefect: effectiveKeys() returned defaultKeys raw while chordMatches() compared it to the always-normalized output of chordFromEvent with ===. Any default not already in normal form matched nothing, silently. 8 of 101 catalog defaults were in that state, plus 2 more (Shift+[ / Shift+]) that normal form allows but chordFromEvent cannot produce.
fixes: effectiveKeys normalizes on the way out; the two nav.*Desktop literals corrected to Ctrl+Meta+Arrow*.

The ten video.* registrations deleted from MediaContent useMedia and registered by VideoCoreStudyOverlay against the adopted player. Its hardcoded event.code switch removed, so there is exactly one dispatcher.
video.* defaults re-pointed onto R/W/S/;/' — the codes the overlay already chose from what vc_defaultKeybindings leaves free. Five rows unbound rather than given a colliding default.
MediaStudyMode opens the adopted workspace via openMediaWorkspace({localFilePath,startAtSec}); isPlayerVisible, onSeek and the jp-pending-study-media-seek sessionStorage handoff are gone.
reachMediaWorkspace() in mediaWorkspaceBridge owns the host-then-sidecar sequence for its two callers.

chunkMeasurement.question: Did importing keyboardShortcuts into VideoCoreStudyOverlay pull the shortcut catalog into the lazy media chunk?
chunkMeasurement.method: grep the built chunks for a catalog-only literal (nav.nextDesktop)
chunkMeasurement.result: No. nav.nextDesktop is in localAgentAutomationStore-*.js and the three language chunks; StudyPlayerSlice-*.js carries only the ten command-id strings the overlay registers.

notProvenLive: Nobody has pressed R in a running window. The dispatch is proven end to end in a real engine (jsdom KeyboardEvent through installKeyboardShortcuts), and the overlay wiring is proven by source guard, not by watching a cue replay.
